build_pixel_shuffle_pack: create a PixelShufflePack module with in_channels, out_channels, scale_factor, and upsample_kernel
run_pixel_shuffle_forward: run the forward pass of a PixelShufflePack on a torch tensor input
init_pixel_shuffle_weights: initialize PixelShufflePack convolution weights using Xavier uniform distribution
build_upsample_layer: build an upsample layer from a config dict specifying type and scale_factor
register_upsample_mode: register nearest or bilinear upsample modes in the MODELS registry
